items.title: Web3Auth says it frontran hackers by moving $5.6 million out of exposed Keplr wallets
items.sum: Web3Auth's communications also referred to an original attacker, suggesting some funds were stolen, but did not elaborate.

items.title: The catch in recovering a hacked crypto wallet: the thief may still have a key
items.sum: Keplr's documented backups can reduce login dependence, but they cannot establish that a potentially exposed key is safe.

items.title: Vitalik Buterin says ETH should be valued as a store of value, not a fee-burning token
items.sum: A recent controversial proposal to burn a rising share of validator rewards as more ETH is staked was withdrawn last month after facing pushback.

items.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs post $530M outflows as election gains evaporate
items.sum: US spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs shed a combined $530 million Thursday as Bitcoin fell below $76,000 and US stocks tumbled.

items.title: Thailand is cutting off Bitget. Users have until December 5 to prepare
items.sum: The regulator asks customers to consider action on holdings before the block, while Bitget promises guidance on service access.

items.title: U.S. Treasury Cuts Off MEXC From U.S. Financial System Over Alleged $16 Billion in Illicit Flows
items.sum: FinCEN issued a final order under section 9714(a) that will bar U.S. financial institutions from sending or receiving funds with MEXC Global.

items.title: What the election results mean for crypto: State of Crypto
items.sum: Democrats had an astoundingly good night, smashing all expectations. Is that actually bad news for the industry?

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs flip negative for 2026 after $1.28 billion outflow week, worst since June
items.sum: BlackRock's IBIT accounted for 98% of Friday's outflows, with $403 million leaving the industry-leading fund.

items.title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card numbers, home addresses and linked crypto wallets
items.sum: One user said the exposed data tied his home address and card number to every crypto wallet linked to his account, raising the risk of targeted scams.

items.title: Binance France emails announce closure of its users' accounts on Dec. 31
items.sum: Any assets left on the exchange will be charged monthly fees starting on Nov. 29, company says.

items.title: This Bitcoin Developer's Idea Would Make Quantum Attacks a Losing Bet
items.sum: Cory Fields wants future quantum attackers to post Bitcoin as collateral before touching vulnerable wallets.

items.title: These Finland homes get free heat from bitcoin miners (as long as BTC stays above $70,000)
items.sum: A Finnish startup has 30 bitcoin mining systems working as central heating.

items.title: Ex-FBI agent pleads guilty to stealing $2.47 million in crypto from wallets tied to 35 investigations
items.sum: Yaroch will pay at least $2.4 million in restitution.

items.title: One BlackRock fund dominates Bitcoin's billion-dollar ETF exodus
items.sum: Fidelity finished positive in the November 2-6 week, but the other funds collectively remained negative without IBIT.

items.title: Treasury Cuts Crypto Exchange MEXC Off From US Financial System
items.sum: FinCEN's order bars U.S. institutions from any transfers to or from MEXC.

items.title: Binance CFO steps down nine days after record hack; co-CEO says transition was planned six months ago
items.sum: Co-CEO Yi He said Ng is departing to pursue a new venture.

items.title: Stablecoin growth has stalled. The payments boom hasn't
items.sum: Stablecoin supply has barely grown this year, even as payments using the tokens surge.
